purpose: Reusable data context for football intelligence analysis, QA, dashboards and model evaluation.

qualityGates.database: DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_URL or SUPABASE_DB_URL must be configured before schema apply.
qualityGates.odds: ODDS_API_KEY or THE_ODDS_API_KEY plus ODDS_API_URL_TEMPLATE must be configured before ROI/CLV reporting.
qualityGates.prediction: Probabilities must sum to 1 and high confidence is blocked below 0.70 data completeness.
qualityGates.leakage: generated_at and cutoff_at must be before kickoff_at for pre-match snapshots.
qualityGates.lineage: Prediction-impacting fields should have source audit metadata.

recommendedNextActions: Fill DATABASE_URL or POSTGRES_URL in Vercel.
Backfill source_records and source_audit from current JSON cache.
Connect dashboard sections to database-backed API responses.
Enable odds/closing-line KPI reporting only after real credentials are present.
